Remark
[$H(X,Y)$ is quadratic in $Y$] ↗ prop:l-length-hessian-inequality

In spite of the notation, $H(X,Y)$ is a purely quadratic function of the vector field $Y$ along $\gamma _Z$.

We begin the proof of this proposition with three elementary lemmas. The first is an immediate consequence of the definition of $\widetilde{\mathcal U}_x(\bar\tau )$.
